question: Should OpenClaw accept `search_context_size` as a shared model-facing `web_search` parameter for Perplexity once the branch is rebased and live provider proof is supplied?
rationale: The patch adds a new agent-visible tool parameter and provider behavior; source and docs support the shape, but maintainer product/API ownership should decide whether this surface belongs in core-bundled Perplexity now.

options.title: Accept after proof and rebase
options.body: Require a conflict-free branch plus redacted live provider proof, then land the narrow schema/runtime/docs/tests change.

options.title: Keep issue open and request a narrower path
options.body: Ask for a replacement PR that only targets the supported Perplexity transport or adjusts the shared schema wording before merge.

options.title: Reject the surface for now
options.body: Close or pause the PR and leave the linked issue open only if maintainers do not want this model-facing parameter in OpenClaw yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Require a conflict-free branch plus redacted live provider proof, then land the narrow schema/runtime/docs/tests change.

likelyOwner.reason: kesku introduced the native Perplexity Search API route that now owns the main behavior boundary for this option.
